# DOMPurify 3.4.17

`purify.es.mjs` is copied unchanged from the DOMPurify 3.4.17 package resolved by the pinned `@cesium/engine` toolchain. It supplies HTML sanitization for the optional browser credit renderer. This is browser host code; Cesium Core algorithms and resource scheduling run in Rust.

DOMPurify is used under its Apache-2.0 option. The upstream license is included as `DOMPurify-LICENSE`; the source retains its copyright/license header.
